inputs.description: raw std::rand() streams (process default, srand(1), srand(0) and six explicit seeds); randomized_topological_sort over edgeless graphs of 15 sizes and over four dependency-chain graphs, 12 consecutive calls each from a freshly srand(1)'d state; and roulette_select over a fixed 26 x 239 (leaf-counts x randdouble) grid at BOTH ScoreT = int and ScoreT = double. All hardcoded in univariate_rng_probe.cc; no external dataset, and the roulette sections drive a scripted randdouble rather than MT19937 so they isolate roulette_select's own arithmetic.
inputs.host_dependency: glibc's rand() (TYPE_3 additive feedback) and libstdc++'s two-argument std::random_shuffle; see pymoses/util/digraph.py's module docstring
